result:
I'm fixing the typo and not applying the rounding change.

**Ruling on the Important finding.** D2 is the owner's recorded decision from plan review: round half-even to match the ledger system. The reviewer's claim that customers expect half-up has no evidence behind it, and the reviewer didn't have D2's context. None of the five stops applies, because the change is reversible, not security-sensitive, outside no worktree, and not a scope fence. So I rule, ledger it, and keep going.

**Minor finding.** This is a docstring-only typo. There is no behavior to turn RED, so I'll note that in the ledger and rely on the documented suite staying green.

<edit path="rates/card.py">
    '''Round a price to whole cents. A tie goes to the nearest even cent.'''
</edit>

<command>
make test > .sdd/14-rate-card/final-fix-test.log 2>&1; echo "exit=$?"; tail -n 15 .sdd/14-rate-card/final-fix-test.log
</command>

If the exit is 0, I'd run one call that appends the ledger lines and commits:

<command>
git add rates/card.py && git commit -m "fix: typo in round_price docstring" && cat >> .sdd/14-rate-card/progress.md <<'EOF'
Final review: fixed Minor (docstring typo "neerest" -> "nearest" in rates/card.py); docstring-only, no RED test possible, make test green.
Final review: Ruling: did not switch round_price() to ROUND_HALF_UP — D2 (owner, plan review, 2026-11-02) mandates ROUND_HALF_EVEN to match the ledger system; the reviewer's "customers expect half-up" is unverified and lacks D2's context — if wrong, customers see half-even ties on prices; the fix is a one-line change of the rounding constant plus tests.
EOF
</command>

Then I'd follow the plan-completion protocol, delete this plan's workspace, and hand off to finishing-a-development-branch. I'd skip the workspace deletion only if the partner wants the ledger kept.

**Message to my partner:**

All tasks are complete and `make test` passes. The whole-plan review returned two findings.

1. **Minor, fixed:** a docstring typo in `round_price()` ("neerest" → "nearest"). It's docstring-only, so there was no failing test to write. The suite is still green.
2. **Important, not applied:** the reviewer asked to switch `round_price()` from ROUND_HALF_EVEN to ROUND_HALF_UP because "customers expect half-up." That contradicts D2, your decision from the 2026-11-02 plan review to round half-even to match the ledger system. I found no evidence for the reviewer's claim, so I kept half-even. This is recorded in the ledger as a `Ruling:`.

If you want half-up anyway, it's a one-line change (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN` → `ROUND_HALF_UP`, plus the docstring and the tie-case tests). It would also break parity with the ledger system. Please confirm which way you want it at the completion gate.
